newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes weaker against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes weaker against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker against the dollar at 42.5490/5500 in interbank trading compared with the previous close of 42.5485/5500, dealers said.

Dealers said the taka was steady after opening at 42.5490/5500 despite demand for dollars from importers and banks. The was because the rates had almost hit the ceiling of the central bank band, they said.
Call money rates in interbank market opened closed at 7.0 percent to 7.5 percent against the previous 6-8 percent.
